indications.description: First-line locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC with activating EGFR mutations
Switch-maintenance locally advanced/metastatic activating-EGFR NSCLC with stable disease after first-line chemotherapy
Locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC after failure of at least one prior chemotherapy regimen; NCCP global eligibility still requires validated activating EGFR mutation

treatment.schedule_summary: 150 mg once daily continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
administration_instructions: 150 mg by mouth once daily, at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after food.
Do not replace a missed dose; resume the usual next dose. Do not repeat a dose vomited within a few hours.
Review smoking, acid-suppressing medicines, CYP interactions and warfarin with pharmacy.

action.message: Smoking reduces erlotinib exposure. Support cessation and review smoking changes; do not automatically increase the dose. EMA reports no demonstrated benefit of 300 mg versus 150 mg in active smokers.
action.recommendation: Smoking reduces erlotinib exposure. Support cessation and review smoking changes; do not automatically increase the dose. EMA reports no demonstrated benefit of 300 mg versus 150 mg in active smokers.

action.message: Avoid proton pump inhibitors. If antacids are necessary, source timing is at least 4 hours before or 2 hours after erlotinib. EMA specifically describes ranitidine with erlotinib at least 2 hours before or 10 hours after; this historical example is not a recommendation to prescribe ranitidine or apply its interval to every H2 blocker. Pharmacy must confirm an available individual alternative.

regular: FBC, renal and liver profile every 60 days.
Additional renal/electrolyte checks, including potassium, for diarrhoea/dehydration; closer liver tests with pre-existing impairment or hepatotoxic medicines.
disease: Disease monitoring and scans per supervising Consultant plan.

dose_modifications: Only the currently structured inputs and decision rules are operational in SACTCheck. Renal and hepatic source requirements may still require manual review of the current official NCCP PDF.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT

source_conflicts: NCCP 00219c indication wording does not repeat EGFR selection, but global NCCP eligibility requires validated activating EGFR mutation. EMA historical wild-type exception is not silently added.
NCCP v6 footer last clinical review remains 10 March 2021; version-history amendment on 20 May 2026 concerns review schedule and antiemetic links.
Source hepatic phrase uses AST and ALT >5 ×ULN; a highest-value alias alone cannot establish both or clinical severe dysfunction.
